capabilities: Highlight, underline and strike out PDF text
Add text boxes and sticky notes
Export annotations to a Markdown note
Burn annotations into the PDF file
extras: Free and open source (MIT), no account, ads or telemetry; works offline. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or newer. Bundles pdf.js 3.11, which npm flags for CVE-2024-4367, but the plugin forces isEvalSupported false and strips eval/new Function. Burn-in is one-way; a timestamped backup of the original is kept. Installation notes say 'after the plugin is published', so it may not yet be in the community directory.
intentEvidence: it is an independent implementation built on pdf.js and pdf-lib
problem: Obsidian can open PDFs but has no built-in way to highlight, draw on, or annotate them and keep those marks inside the vault.

relations.evidence: The feature set was inspired by reading tools the community already loves — Ink-Annotation, PDF.notes and PDF++
